content.title: US Senate Race in Mississippi: Democrat Scott Colom Leads Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith by 3,783 Votes
content.caption: Democrats are leading in the race for the US Senate in Mississippi, with Democrat Scott Colom leading Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith by 3,783 votes.

slides.heading: US Senate Race in Mississippi
slides.text: Democrats lead Republican in Mississippi Senate race by 3,783 votes.
slides.image_search_query: US Senate race in Mississippi United States

slides.heading: Key Details
slides.text: Democrats Scott Colom leads Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith by 3,783 votes. Colom is Mississippi's first Black senator since 1881. Hyde-Smith is the incumbent Republican senator.
slides.image_search_query: US Senate race in Mississippi details United States

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: Colom's lead is significant, with 98% of votes counted. Democrats are expected to win the race, which will be a remarkable upset in a state that hasn't elected a Democrat as senator since 1982.
